audit_items.proof_trace: TOCTOU race: blocks are validated as canonical via IsCanonical() during batch.canonical() filtering, but fork choice can change before dataColumnStorage.Get() retrieves sidecars. Storage layer has no canonicality check, serving orphaned block sidecars to peers during reorgs.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker requests data columns during reorg window. Victim node filters blocks as canonical at T0, reorg occurs at T1, node serves orphaned block sidecars at T2. Peer receives non-canonical data violating fork choice chain invariant.
